description:
Updates and persists the cookie consent banner UI configuration, Google Consent Mode v2 synchronization, and pre-consent tracker blocking rules for an existing monitored site.

When to use vs. related tools: Call 'configure_cookie_banner' first to customize visual theme, placement, copy, accent hex color, and GCM v2 blocking flags on a registered site; afterward, call 'get_cookie_banner_script' (for CMS/web embeds) or 'get_consent_banner_code' (for GCM v2 Basic/Advanced code). Call 'list_sites' or 'add_site' first if you do not have a valid 'siteId'.

Preconditions & side effects: 'siteId' MUST match an existing site ID or registered domain in the workspace registry (no silent fallback to default sites). Mutates the target site's 'cookie_banner' configuration in-memory.

Returns: On success, returns 'success: true', 'siteId', 'site_name', persisted 'banner_configuration', 'preview_url', 'embed_script', and 'message'. On invalid accent color or unknown siteId, returns 'success: false', 'error', and 'available_sites'.

accent_color.description: 6-digit hexadecimal color code for primary accept buttons and highlights.

auto_block_trackers.description: Withhold non-essential analytics and marketing tags until affirmative user opt-in.

banner_message.description: Explanatory consent body copy shown to visitors before choice selection.
examples: We use essential and analytics cookies to measure traffic and improve your experience.

banner_title.description: Primary heading displayed at the top of the cookie consent notice.

enable_gcm_v2.description: Enable automatic synchronization with Google Consent Mode v2 signals.

position.description: Viewport anchor position for the banner or consent modal.

siteId.description: Registered site UUID (e.g. 'site_paperloo_sandbox') or exact registered domain URL.

theme.description: Visual appearance preset for the consent banner.

name: configure_cookie_banner

outputSchema.description: Result of updating a site's cookie consent banner configuration.

available_sites.description: Registered sites returned when siteId is not found.

items.description: Summary entry for a registered monitored website.

banner_configuration.description: Saved cookie consent banner configuration object.

accent_color.description: 6-digit hex accent color applied to primary actions.

auto_block_trackers.description: Whether prior-consent script blocking is active.

banner_title.description: Heading text displayed on the banner.

categories.description: Consent categories enabled on the banner.

enable_gcm_v2.description: Whether Google Consent Mode v2 sync is enabled.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of this configuration update.

embed_script.description: Ready-to-paste HTML script tag loading the configured banner.

error.description: Validation or lookup error when success is false.

preview_url.description: Interactive Paperloo preview URL for the banner.

site_name.description: Human-readable name of the updated site.

success.description: True if banner settings were validated and saved; false otherwise.

title: Configure Site Cookie Consent Banner
